notes.title: Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions- Released on Steam!
notes.content:
Happy Friday, we hope you're doing fantastic! We're pleased to announce that Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions- has officially released on Steam! If you enjoyed Machina of the Planet Tree -Planet Ruler- we hope you'll give this new release a try~ That's all we have to share with you today and we hope the rest of your day is great!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209720/Machina_of_the_Planet_Tree_Unity_Unions/

notes.title: Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions- Releasing on Friday, May 15th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In case you didn't see the news, Unity Unions, the next installment in the Machina of the Planet Tree series, is releasing THIS Friday on Steam! Unity Unions is a magic casting 3D action RPG. It's also available in multiple languages (JP/EN/CN) so that more fans can enjoy the series. 

[i]This is a story that takes place after the events of Machina of the Planet Tree -Planet Ruler-. Corona Megistus is a young girl who comes from a family of gemstone magicians. While out training, a chance encounter causes her to come into contact with the core of the Machina, Arcturus. His appearance is a sign that the peace the world has enjoyed is in danger as the seal on a great evil begins to weaken. With the world in danger, the novice gemstone magician departs on a journey with Arcturus to hone her powers and prevent the return of Nova.[/i]

Go on and wishlist the game on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209720/Machina_of_the_Planet_Tree_Unity_Unions/
